## Definition of done

- [ ] Works in the main scene (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Game.unity`) on the latest `main`
- [ ] No new Console errors or warnings
- [ ] Tested in a build, not only in the Editor
- [ ] Tests pass (**Window > General > Test Runner**, EditMode and PlayMode)
- [ ] Only Unity Registry packages (`python tools/check-packages.py` passes)
- [ ] New assets have their `.meta` files committed; large binaries go through Git LFS
- [ ] Owner added or updated their slide in `Docs/Deck/Deck-Outline.md`
- [ ] Reviewed and merged by someone other than the author
